reviews.review: This is a all time classic and one of the best. You can't go wrong with this game. I started with Flash Point and till today.

the a.i in this game is both the very best a.i i have ever seen in a video game to date and also the very worst a.i i have ever seen to date.

this game, despite how you may view it, is based off the original operation flashpoint (now named arma cold war assault) engine. this explains why it runs like ♥♥♥♥. (though it runs NOTICABLY better than how it did a few years ago, especially with massive AI amounts. even my old ass pc can run it with 60 fps average now.)

the optimization is still something to be fixed upon, there are many things that could be done to make it run better (not that i could list them. i just know there are more options than what current arma does.) but as it is currently, optimizations pretty great.

earlier i mentioned the a.i, to explain the bits that i know of it, A.I are both terminator A.I and bonzi buddy A.I running simultaniously, one taking control of the other whenever it feels like it. a.i may very well blitz you through bushes, commit suppressive fire and somehow kill you, or even just sheer dumb luck 1km rifle headshots, but then will have problems trying to take out a man standing completely still.

the a.i will proceed to see through grass and shrubbery, but then be completely blind the next. and yes, they can see through grass. (install ACSTG AI cannot see through grass to fix this. this should really be in the vanilla game...)

the a.i can see through smoke (even smoke that has fully appeared, unlike what redditors and midwits will tell you.) but then will throw their own smoke and somehow blind themselves, forcing them to do suppressive fire to hit you. (and, well, because its arma a.i, you will probably be hit anyway, as their means of suppressive fire is disasterously accurate at hitting more than it actually is at suppressing.) (also, install splendid smoke to fix the issue of smoke grenades not working for its intended purpose. believe me, it works. again, another mod that should be incorporated in vanilla.)

but that isn't to downplay just how good the vanilla arma a.i is. without any mods, they are extremely good at what they perform. people tend to get the idea that vanilla arma a.i are bad, because they see their friendly a.i (usually ones in your squad, ones that you are supposed to command.) not doing much and only staying in formation, thus usually being killed due to bad positioning as they will try to orbit around the player. but, if you command them PROPERLY, setting them to "Engage at Will" (hit tilde, press 3, then press 5.) they will break formation and engage targets in whatever way the a.i feels is the most comfortable. this will make them act equally as good as enemy a.i, who people like to state get given "additional abilities than your own" when that simply isn't true.

but thats just the a.i, there are more things in arma than just a.i (i don't play PVP so i don't have anything to say about it.) there are things like the overall look, feel, and sound that arma provides. it's a very unique game, that does the bare minimum required to achieve its goal. although with enough setup, you can get some pretty complex scenes going. (the weather system is especially interesting.)

and, much like other games, arma is a game that is heavily stimulated by its modding community. see huge games like ACE3, that truly transform arma from a "tactical lite" to a full on tactical, realism simulation. they can completely transform this game into something else entirely, or import assets from other games to be played here. experience half life 2 in arma, or warhammer 40k in arma, or import real world vehicles, weapons, equipment, and units into the game. the possibilities are endless.

arma by itself is a good game. mods greatly improve the experience, but aren't needed. you can play through bootcamp, and the east wind campaign, from start to finish, without issues, by just playing the vanilla game. you'll have some learning pains having to command the  a.i, especially since the east wind campaign forces you to do this (do learn it, not because of the east wind campaign, but because of how useful the a.i can be if you take the time to properly learn it. especially since it'll give you an edge on other players should you ever play PVE multiplayer, or even PVP multiplayer.)

i give this game...a "i just got blitzed through 6 million blades of grass by a 9mm blasting FIA guerilla fighter who has no scope, no NVGs, no flashlight, no laser pointer, not even a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ clue i was present, yet still managed to dome me straight in the head and instantly kill me, forcing me to load a save from 4 ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ hours ago." out of 10. amazing game!!!!!!!
The base "Game" is just a storefront to sell you the remaining 80% of the game through DLC. Just a few single-player missions and online play.
